name: Abronicidae
auth: Korshunova, Martynov, Bakken, Evertsen, Fletcher, Mudianta, H. Saito, Lundin, Schrödl & Picton, 2017

children.name: Abronica
children.auth: Cella, Carmona, Ekimova, Chichvarkhin, Schepetov & Gosliner, 2016

desc: Abronica is a genus of nudibranchs, shell-less marine gastropod molluscs or sea slugs, and the only member of the family Abronicidae, which was first named in 2017.
